method: warm file cache; ASCII plain text; no user config, swap, LSP or extensions; VSCLI recovery as recorded in recovery_enabled; spawn-to-visible-marker and serial key-to-observed-PTY-cell; includes Python oracle; excludes graphical terminal painting and physical input; Linux RSS sums the process tree and counts shared pages per process; sampled RSS is not peak memory
comparison_provenance: Optimized main build after PR52, preserved before feature branch release build; both binaries built with cargo build --release --locked.
qualification: Five fresh processes per editor/fixture and 200 keystrokes per editor/fixture; interleaved warm-cache ASCII core-only workload, no concurrent local builds/tests. No LSP, extension, recovery or full-IDE performance claim.
